name: Student Volunteer Program
org: The Arboretum (Los Angeles County Arboretum and Botanic Garden)
what_you_do: Help in the gardens, at the visitor desk, in the office or at one-day events. You can earn service hours for school.
who_can_apply: High school students. You must be at least 14.
pay_detail: Volunteer position with no pay. The Live Scan fingerprint cost is not listed.
deadline_text: The page says it is accepting applications as of Nov 3, 2026. The program runs all year, and no deadline is listed.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Student Volunteer application with its three forms. Do the Live Scan. Email it all to the Volunteer Coordinator. The coordinator sets up an interview to place you. Questions: 626.821.3222.
notes: LA County requires all volunteers to be at least 14, with no exceptions. The Arboretum is at 301 North Baldwin Ave, Arcadia.
